Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: A website for exploring the [metadata standard](metadata-standard.qmd): its parts, how they relate, and their attributes. You can also download a custom machine-readable schema built on MetaFleX, for example as a model for [SlideTap](slidetap.qmd).

  [Currently hosted as *bpmetrics*.]{.text-muted}

Who it's for
: Data contributors and data users who work with the metadata on a technical level.

Provided by
: Radboudumc

Before you start
: [Nothing needed: the website is public]{.proto-none}

How to get access
: [Open the Metadata standard browser](https://bpmetrics-config.tools.balsever.se/)

Guides
: [None: the website explains itself]{.proto-none}
